sources.label: kestrel relay
sources.text: Kestrel relay forwards an item only when its route stamp equals the active route stamp. A mismatched stamp causes the item to be held without forwarding.

sources.label: marble store
sources.text: Marble store accepts an incoming version only when it is strictly greater than the stored version. An equal or lower version is rejected and the stored record remains unchanged.

sources.label: willow survey
sources.text: Willow survey counts a plot only when the recorded daily rainfall is at least 5 millimetres. With less rainfall it postpones the count and records a missing observation rather than zero.

sources.label: topaz voucher
sources.text: Topaz voucher redeems a purchase only when available credits are at least the purchase cost. On redemption it subtracts the cost from available credits. If credits are insufficient it rejects the purchase without changing credits.
